name: DNA Foundation Models Genomic Sequence Classification Benchmark
description: Evaluates DNA foundation models on genomic sequence classification tasks to compare model architectures and training strategies.
evaluation_method: AUROC (primary; often reported with F1/AUPRC as complements)
reputation: An emerging benchmark in computational genomics for comparing DNA foundation models; gaining attention among genomics and ML researchers.
notes: Caveats include potential pretraining/data contamination, strong task-dependent variance, class imbalance on some tasks, and that performance can saturate on small or easy tasks; not limited to LLMs (works with sequence models).
